en.headline: HK Express cancels Okinawa and Ishigaki flights as Typhoon Dolphin approaches
en.dek: Multiple services between Hong Kong and Okinawa from Thursday to Saturday, plus Saturday Ishigaki flights, are cancelled; the carrier added an extra pair of flights on Wednesday.
body: HK Express has cancelled a series of flights to Okinawa and Ishigaki between Thursday and Saturday because of Tropical Cyclone Dolphin, which is expected to affect the region south of Japan.

All Hong Kong–Okinawa flights on Friday have been cancelled. Selected services on Thursday (UO844, UO845, UO824 and UO825) and Saturday (UO842 and UO843) are also cancelled, along with Saturday’s Hong Kong–Ishigaki flights UO858 and UO879.

To help affected passengers, the airline operated additional flights on Wednesday: UO8842 from Hong Kong to Okinawa departing at 5pm and the return UO8843. Passengers may accept the alternative arrangements, rebook for free, change destination between Okinawa and Ishigaki at no charge, or request a refund before the original departure time.
Greater Bay Airlines also cancelled its Hong Kong–Okinawa services on Friday and Saturday. The Hong Kong Observatory said Dolphin’s direct threat to the territory remains low.

zh.headline: 白海豚逼近 香港快運取消沖繩石垣多班航班
zh.dek: 周四至周六多班往返沖繩航班及周六石垣航班取消，快運周三已加開特別航班疏導旅客。
body: 受熱帶氣旋白海豚影響，香港快運已取消周四至周六多班往返沖繩及石垣的航班。
周五所有往返香港與沖繩的航班取消；周四部分航班（UO844、UO845、UO824、UO825）及周六部分航班（UO842、UO843）亦取消，周六往返石垣的UO858及UO879同樣取消。
快運周三特別加開UO8842（香港17:00飛沖繩）及回程UO8843，供受影響旅客選擇。旅客可接受新安排、免費改期、免費更改航線（限沖繩或石垣）或申請退款，須於原定起飛前辦理。
大灣區航空亦取消周五及周六往返沖繩的航班。天文台表示，白海豚對本港的直接威脅不高。
